title: Hold a licence or registration to transport waste
what: Hold the environment regulator's licence, registration or permit before transporting controlled or regulated waste.

sources.title: Environment Protection Act 1993 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: 36—Requirement for licence (1) A person must not undertake a prescribed activity of environmental significance except as authorised by an environmental authorisation in the form of a licence under this Part.

reach.note: Liquid, hazardous and industrial waste collection.

assessment.summary: Transporting regulated waste needs an environmental licence, registration or permit, and each load is tracked.

marks.reason: A licence or registration is needed before transporting regulated waste.
